prompt.zh-TW: 星橋物流今年本期淨利 {{money:vars.ni}}，股本 {{money:vars.capital}}，每股面額 {{money:vars.par}}。依課程 Excel 口徑（股本 ÷ 每股面額推算股數）計算每股盈餘（EPS），以「元／股」作答。
prompt.en: Starbridge Logistics had profit for the period of {{money:vars.ni}}, share capital of {{money:vars.capital}} and a par value of {{money:vars.par}} per share. Using the course Excel basis (number of shares = share capital ÷ par value), what is earnings per share (EPS)? Answer in dollars per share.

explanation.zh-TW: 先把{{term:tm_5e3py55a}} {{money:vars.capital}} 除以每股面額 {{money:vars.par}} 換成股數，再用{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}除以股數，才是{{term:tm_knqbr6g4}}。直接用股本金額當分母，算出來的是「每一元股本賺多少」，不是每股。
explanation.en: First convert {{term:tm_5e3py55a}} of {{money:vars.capital}} into a number of shares by dividing by the par value of {{money:vars.par}}, then divide {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} by that number to get {{term:tm_knqbr6g4}}. Dividing by the share capital amount instead gives earnings per dollar of capital, not per share.
